articles.title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
articles.snippet: The incident marks the first time Trezor customers' shipping addresses were exposed.

articles.title: B2C2 taps Schroders veteran to chase Asia’s growing crypto wealth
articles.snippet: The institutional crypto liquidity provider is bringing on the former Schroders Wealth Management Asia chairman as it targets family offices and asset managers across the region.

articles.title: Bullish shares surge 14% as subscription revenue offsets digital asset slowdown
articles.snippet: Bullish's second-quarter loss of $280 million was mostly attributable to a $244.6 million markdown on the company’s bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury company Metaplanet unveils BitBonds with $1.3 million private debt sale
articles.snippet: The inaugural unsecured bonds offer annual interest of up to 4.3%, while exposing investors to metaplanet’s credit and bitcoin-linked balance-sheet risks

articles.title: Morgan Stanley's infrastructure partner Zerohash rebuffed in pitch to be U.S. trust bank
articles.snippet: Zerohash, which handles crypto plumbing for Morgan Stanley's E*Trade, said it's planning on re-filing and hoping for a swift resolution.
